expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message says the limit was 10 minutes until March 2024, when members on slow mobile connections were logged out before confirming pantry orders and lost their picked items. It explains that the limit rose to 30 minutes to stop this problem and asks for confirmation before changing it back.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 8; first edit at step None
